name: Module Settings
description: Which ZatGo modules this site uses. Switching one off hides it and refuses its ZatGo functions; it never deletes data, and ERPNext's own screens keep working as ERPNext permissions allow.

fields.options: Untick a module to switch it off for this site. A module that another enabled module needs cannot be switched off, and one whose requirements are off cannot be switched on. Nothing is deleted: switching a module back on brings everything back.
